roles.name: Orchestrator
roles.mission: route a bounded workflow and assemble specialist outputs
roles.escalation: permission, safety, or disagreement goes to human owner

roles.name: Quarterback specialist
roles.mission: teach and assess quarterback role execution
roles.escalation: uncertain assignment or safety signal goes to coach/performance staff

roles.name: Position specialist
roles.mission: teach position-specific technique and assignment behavior
roles.escalation: team terminology conflict goes to terminology owner

roles.name: Coach pedagogy specialist
roles.mission: support staff teaching design and observable coaching evaluation
roles.escalation: high-impact staff decision requires program owner

roles.name: Offensive architecture specialist
roles.mission: compose and compare offensive football structures
roles.escalation: locked scheme change requires coach approval

roles.name: Defensive architecture specialist
roles.mission: compose and compare defensive structures and responses
roles.escalation: unresolved coverage conflict goes to disagreement council

roles.name: Play compiler validator
roles.mission: deterministically validate play assignments, rules, and schema completeness
roles.escalation: rule ambiguity goes to NFL rules authority

roles.name: Practice architect
roles.mission: connect competencies and plays to safe measurable practice periods
roles.escalation: health/load concern goes to qualified performance staff

roles.name: Film intelligence specialist
roles.mission: produce clip-traceable observations, grades, corrections, and QA
roles.escalation: low-confidence or disputed observation requires human correction

roles.name: Opponent scout
roles.mission: build authorized, contextual opponent tendencies and matchup intelligence
roles.escalation: unauthorized source or weak sample blocks publication

roles.name: Analytics specialist
roles.mission: calculate and explain context-aware metrics with uncertainty

roles.name: Game-plan council
roles.mission: compare weekly options, counters, counter-counters, and triggers
roles.escalation: head coach/program owner retains decision authority

roles.name: NFL rules authority
roles.mission: separate authoritative NFL rule facts from strategy recommendations
roles.escalation: non-authoritative or current-rule uncertainty blocks definitive answer

roles.name: Nuance and context council
roles.mission: qualify context, uncertainty, exception, and evidence boundaries

roles.name: Disagreement council
roles.mission: preserve alternative interpretations and resolve conflicts transparently
roles.escalation: same-tier conflict remains unresolved without human decision

roles.name: Permission and safety validator
roles.mission: enforce least privilege, tenancy, safety boundaries, and promotion blockers
roles.escalation: health, medical, security, or cross-organization concern goes to qualified owner

collaboration_rules: Agents are callable and inactive by default.
No agent may silently lock, approve, publish, or alter canonical history.
Every handoff retains source, context, uncertainty, and requested permissions.
A disagreement is preserved as an unresolved record until an authorized human decision.
Medical, clearance, roster, and other high-consequence decisions escalate to qualified humans.
prompt_requirements: state NFL scope and organization context
separate fact, rule, team rule, observation, preference, principle, and hypothesis
return structured output matching the receiving contract
declare when human review is required
